evidence: Agent-visible text is task/instruction.md, the six notes copied to /instructions and /assets/seed_data.json (environment/Dockerfile:14-15). (1) The skill's grep `judge|rubric|criteri|dimension|reward|weight|score\.py|playwright|claude|glm|/tests|sentinel` over all of them returns no match. A wider grep (grade|grader|verifier|gate|functional|polish|visual|oracle|harbor|checker|evaluat|assess|points|test|probe|mcp|cw_) hits only ordinary product words: behaviour.md:5 'Keep the latest successful preview' (substring 'test' in 'latest') and security.md:5 'Refuse dynamic evaluation through eval, Function, WebAssembly'. (2) None of the 116 id/name values in the five judge.toml files and scoring.toml (e.g. the cw_ criterion ids) appears in the public text. (3) Verbatim overlap between the public text and every judge.toml/prompt.md/app_context.md, normalised to lowercase words: zero shared runs of 8, 10 or 12 words. (4) Distinctive tokens from the judge files that also occur in public text are only generic product terms (CodeMirror, ProseMirror, JavaScript, WebAssembly, HTML, CSS, DOM, SVG, CDN, HTTP, 3000, 390); no probe literal or sentinel value is named. instruction.md itself is five plain sentences pointing at /instructions and /assets/seed_data.json with no path under /tests. Note: integration.md states the launch contract (node /app/server.js, port 3000, DB_PATH, GET /api/health, cwd outside /app); that is the runtime contract required by row 4, not grader machinery. Note: policy.md:5 says the examples are 'not exact selectors, CSS classes or implementation requirements', which hints that something inspects the app but names no judge, rubric or test path. Limits: the private check-instruction-hygiene.py was not executed; this is a manual application of its documented behaviour. The scripted golden results and the hosted run on an earlier candidate do not exercise this row.
